title: HVAC systems.
officialText:
The design shall consider the effects of the heating, ventilating and air-conditioning (HVAC) systems
on both smoke and fire transport. The analysis shall include all permutations of systems status. The design shall consider the
effects of the fire on the HVAC systems.
